title: Malware detected
shortDescription: Malware Remover or security advisor flagged suspicious files or activity.
fullDescription:
QNAP NAS have historically been targeted by ransomware (Qlocker, DeadBolt, eCh0raider). Malware Remover and QuFirewall detect known strains.

Disconnect from internet immediately, update firmware, run malware remover, change passwords.

Restore clean data from offline backups.
whenToCallPro: If ransomware and no backup, professional recovery; do not pay ransom.

faq.a: No — no guarantee and funds criminals.
Offline backups, disable UPnP, use VPN.

title: System firmware update failed
shortDescription: QTS/QuTS firmware update did not complete.
fullDescription: Failures can result from corrupt download, power interruption, or package conflicts. Recovery via QNAP Qfinder or manual .img flash.

fixSteps.title: Manual firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Download .img from QNAP site and upload.

fixSteps.title: Reset config
fixSteps.instruction: Brief reset button press for system reset, not full factory.

videoSearchQuery: QNAP NAS firmware update failed fix

title: Volume is read-only
shortDescription: Volume has been forced to read-only due to errors.
fullDescription: Filesystem errors or excessive bad sectors trigger read-only to protect data. Run filesystem check; back up immediately.

fixSteps.title: Filesystem check
fixSteps.instruction: Storage & Snapshots > Volume > Check File System.

title: SMART error
shortDescription: Drive reports SMART errors indicating failure.
fullDescription: QTS S.M.A.R.T. monitoring flags drives with reallocated or pending sectors. Replace proactively.

title: HDD bad blocks
shortDescription: Bad sectors detected on a drive.
fullDescription:
Bad blocks accumulate over drive life. Small number can be remapped; many indicates imminent failure.

Run bad block scan; replace if increasing.

title: Fan not working
shortDescription: Fan stopped spinning or RPM abnormal.
fullDescription: Dust or bearing failure. Replace fan to avoid overheating.

faq.q: Safe to run without fan briefly?
faq.a: Very briefly; shutdown if temps rise.

title: PSU redundancy lost
shortDescription: One redundant PSU has failed in rackmount NAS.
fullDescription: Dual PSU units have hot-swap. Failure of one triggers alarm; swap quickly to restore redundancy.

fixSteps.title: Hot-swap
fixSteps.instruction: Remove old and insert new PSU while NAS runs.

faq.q: Safe to use with one PSU?

title: Storage pool degraded
shortDescription: One drive has failed in the pool; rebuild needed.
fullDescription: Replace failed drive with compatible unit; pool auto-rebuilds. Monitor SMART on remaining drives.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Hot-swap new drive of equal or larger size.

title: Not enough space
shortDescription: Volume is nearly full, preventing writes and snapshots.
fullDescription:
Full volume blocks writes, degrades performance, and prevents snapshot creation.

Delete old data, enable recycle bin cleanup, or expand pool.

title: Database error
shortDescription: Photo, Music, or Video Station database is corrupt.
fullDescription: Indexing DB can corrupt after improper shutdown or app update. Rebuild from Multimedia Console.

title: TLS certificate error
shortDescription: HTTPS certificate expired, mismatched, or invalid.
fullDescription:
Default self-signed certs or Let's Encrypt certs expire. Browsers block access.

Renew via Control Panel > Security > Certificate.

fixSteps.title: Use Let's Encrypt
fixSteps.instruction: Free auto-renewing cert for your domain.

videoSearchQuery: QNAP TLS certificate renew Let's Encrypt

title: Backup job failed
shortDescription: HBS (Hybrid Backup Sync) job could not complete.
fullDescription: Common causes: destination full/unreachable, expired credentials, permission issues. Check job log for details.

fixSteps.title: Fix root cause
fixSteps.instruction: Reconnect cloud, free space, update credentials.

title: Drive error
fullDescription: Drive bay reporting error. Common diagnostic indication on QNAP nas. Most issues resolve with reset, firmware update, or hardware swap.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Check for and install latest firmware via app or web UI.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset if needed
fixSteps.instruction: If error persists, factory-reset and reconfigure.

whenToCallPro: If reset and firmware update don't resolve, contact support.

faq.a: Often yes — power-cycling resolves transient errors.
Yes, but don't interrupt power during update.
